input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 喜欢玩在墓地里：喜欢在墓地里玩，A location phrase such as “在墓地里” normally comes before the main verb “玩”.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：假装祭拜，“装” does not directly introduce an action verb in this meaning; use “假装 + verb phrase” to mean pretending to do an action.
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子小的时候：有一个小男孩叫孟子。孟子小的时候，On first mention, introduce the character with a brief noun phrase that identifies who he is, rather than only giving the name.
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里：他和朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence when the named character from the previous sentence has no competing singular referent.
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家：孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬了家，Use 了 for the completed moving event in this past narrative.

items.reason: 地点短语“在墓地里”应放在动词“玩”前面。
“装祭拜”搭配不对，“假装祭拜”是正确的说法。
按教师的首次指称规则，第一次出现孟子时需要先作简短介绍。
这里可用“他”指代刚提到的孟子，但改后仍保留了“玩在墓地里”的语序错误。
“搬家”是叙述中已经完成的事件，应说“搬了家”。
